output.reason: Evidence shows that the RBI “Reserve Bank of India (Pre-payment Charges on Loans) Directions, 2025” was withdrawn/repealed (effective 2025-11-28) and was “no longer in force” as of 2026-11-23. It also shows the earlier 2014 RBI directive on “Levy of Foreclosure Charges/Pre-payment Penalty on” floating rate term loans was withdrawn/repealed effective 2026-01-01 and therefore was also not in force as of 2026-11-23. Thus, the older pre-payment directions cited in the records do not govern on the as-of date stated.
